snippet.title: Veinward Official Trailer | First-Person Mining Incremental
snippet.description:
Veinward is a first-person mining incremental. Mine ore, sell it in town, upgrade your pickaxe and dig deeper. Earn skills, learn to fly, build an estate and pet the cat.

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5133980/Veinward/?utm_source=youtube

Discord: https://discord.gg/sdFzApGC4

#Veinward #indiegame #gamedev
